allowed: Fix bugs that do not change a bot's signal, parameters or sizing
Reliability work: alerts on silent failures, retries, scheduling, merging draft PR #3 on daytrading_bot
Logging, journaling, chain snapshots, fill and slippage capture
Setting ACCOUNT_CAPITAL_USD and the kill-switch thresholds that are still null
Reading the scorecard and writing down what you see
forbidden: New bots or new strategy sweeps looking for a new edge
Changing any strategy parameter, threshold or profile of a bot that is collecting its forward test
New aggregation or ranking layers on top of bots that have no live record
Funding a bot whose scorecard status is BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT DATA, PAUSE, RETIRE or UNDERPERFORMING
exception_rule: An exception is allowed only if you log it first (freeze exception) with the reason and what result would make you reverse it.
